QuestInfo.name: [Crimsonheart] Altarations
QuestInfo.2: You encountered the #b#p2135000##k in #b#m930100000##k, and learned about the #rTwisted Masters#k.
QuestInfo.1: #bRidley#k told you about the Crimsonheart Altar in Crimsonheart Castle. The #b#p2135000##k in #b#m930100000##k has more details.

0.0: Fooled ya! There's no such thing as statue business. But there IS an altar for the #blegendary heroes of Masteria#k in Crimsonwood Keep. It used to hold a set of #blegendary weapons that were used to hold off Naricain#k.
0.1: There was one weapon for each of the guilds, the Stormcasters, the Windreavers, the Shadowknights, the Flamekeepers, and the Bosshunters. But the #rTwisted Masters#k wanted to exploit them and use them for, you know, evil. When they stole them, it threw Masteria into chaos... Probably all part of Naricain's big plan to rule our lands.
0.2: I don't know how they got them in the first place, and I didn't have any way of finding out... until now!
0.3: Now that the #rbarrier#k is down, you can get to #b#m930100000##k! If you can figure out why that #rbarrier's gone#k and what they're using the #blegendary weapons#k for, well that might help us set things right.

yes.0: I KNEW you'd help. Talk to the #b#p2135000##k in #b#m930100000##k. It's the only other statue that doesn't have a personality made of stone.

no.0: Oh, so now you're too good for Masteria?

1.0: Are you a #bforeign warrior#k? Masteria has need of you.

yes.0: Masteria has lost its #rwill to fight#k.

npc.0: Take the #bbottom right#k portal to the #r#m930100000##k. The #p2135000## should be there.
